summary: This directory serves as a foundational shared library, providing a collection of utility functions, core services, and helper modules that support consistent data processing, environmental management, and system-wide operations across the codebase.
responsibilities: Provide fundamental data manipulation and transformation utilities
Encapsulate cross-cutting service logic and runtime context
Ensure consistent application-wide operations for files, parameters, and system state
Support common development tasks through shared programming abstractions
relationships: Utility modules provide the low-level processing tools that core services use to execute complex application logic.
The runtime context provides environment-specific data that informs how various services operate within the system.
Shared transformations facilitate the consistent interpretation of data across diverse services including file system, parameter, and variable management.
designDecisions: Centralize common code in a shared location to prevent duplication
Utilize service-oriented patterns for core application capabilities
Expose shared functionality through index modules for organized consumption
Prioritize type safety and modularity in shared implementations
